tool_analysis:
Step Analysis:
- The recorded browser session logs show a full create-subcategory flow in Magento 1.9: login (already handled), navigate to Catalog > Manage Categories, close informational popup, select a parent node in the left tree, click 'Add Subcategory', fill Name/Is Active/URL Key, open Display Settings, set Display Mode/CMS Block/Is Anchor, and Save Category. Post-save the session validated the presence of a success message and new tree node.

Task Definition:
- This tool automates creation of a subcategory under an existing parent category and sets the main attributes required by most Magento stores: name, url_key, is_active, display_mode, cms_block (landing_page), and is_anchor. Authentication is out-of-scope (assumes an authenticated browser context).

Action Plan (ordered):
1. Navigate to the admin categories page (start URL). 2. Close blocking incoming-message popup. 3. Select the parent tree node by exact visible label. 4. Click 'Add Subcategory'. 5. Wait for form to load and populate required General fields (Name, Is Active, URL Key). 6. Open Display Settings and set Display Mode, CMS Block and Is Anchor. 7. Click Save Category. 8. Extract page notifications and category tree to verify creation.

Variable Identification (inputs required):
- base_url: exact admin categories URL used to start. 
- parent_category_name: exact visible text of the parent node. Using the exact visible label (including counts) is the most deterministic way to pick the right tree node.
- name, url_key, is_active (visible text 'Yes'/'No'), display_mode (visible option text), cms_block (visible option text), is_anchor (visible text). 
- wait_timeout: optional timeout for loader waits.

Step Optimization and Determinism:
- Use ID-based selectors where Magento provides them (input#name, input#url_key, select#is_active, select#display_mode, select#is_anchor, select[name='landing_page']). These are stable across Magento 1.x admin installations and avoid brittle text-only selectors.
- Use exact visible-text XPath to select the parent category node and the 'Add Subcategory' control; this mirrors the recorded actions and is deterministic when the caller supplies the visible text exactly.
- Close the 'Incoming Message' popup first to avoid blocked clicks; rely on a title='close' anchor which is stable in the default admin skin.
- After Save, extract notifications and the left-hand tree to validate success rather than relying only on the presence/absence of loaders.

Missing/Assumed Elements:
- The tool assumes the session is already logged in (no auth steps included). 
- It assumes standard Magento 1.x IDs/names are present (input#name, select#is_active, input#url_key, select#display_mode, select[name='landing_page'], select#is_anchor). If a custom admin theme or module changed IDs then the label-relative XPaths from the recorded session should be used as fallbacks (these are documented above in the analysis). 

Selector robustness and failure mitigation:
- If an ID selector fails in practice, the operator should confirm the element's id/name and substitute the label-based XPath (provided in the analysis notes). 
- The tool uses short waits and explicit small pauses to reduce flakiness, and a final extraction step to confirm success. 

Security and environment notes:
- Do not include credentials in the tool; it assumes an authenticated browser context. 
- The tool will try several common Save selectors to accommodate slightly different admin skins. 

Overall: This tool provides a single deterministic flow to create a subcategory and set the typical attributes shown during the recorded session. It uses stable ID-based selectors where available and label/XPath fallbacks in the analysis so integrators can adapt selectors if their Magento admin UI differs.
name: magento_create_subcategory
description: Create a new subcategory under an existing Magento 1.x admin category and set common attributes (name, url_key, is_active, display settings). Assumes the browser session is already authenticated into the Magento admin UI. Uses stable ID-based selectors where possible with label/XPath fallbacks.

steps.description: Open the Magento Admin Categories page (starting point for creating a subcategory).
Short pause to allow page resources to start loading (will be followed by loader checks).
Close any 'Incoming Message' popup if present (non-modal close anchor with title='close').
Give the UI a moment to remove the popup before interacting with the tree.
Select the parent category in the left-hand category tree by exact visible text. Use the exact label (include count parentheses if shown).
Allow the category form to load for the selected parent (wait for form fields to appear).
Click the 'Add Subcategory' control to open the new-subcategory form under the selected parent.
Wait for the new-subcategory form to appear and for any initial loaders to finish.
Extra stabilization wait to reduce flakiness (small polling gap).
Fill the required Name field for the new category. Uses the ID-based selector input#name (robust for default Magento 1 installs).
Set the 'Is Active' select (use visible option text 'Yes' or 'No').
Fill the URL Key field (if empty string provided, this will set it empty and Magento may auto-generate it on save).
Open the 'Display Settings' tab to set display-related attributes.
Wait for the Display Settings panel content to become visible.
Set 'Display Mode' to the requested option (use the visible option text exactly).
Select the requested CMS Block (landing_page). Uses name/id fallbacks: select[name='landing_page'] or select#landing_page. Provide the exact visible option label.
Set 'Is Anchor' under Display Settings (use visible option text 'Yes' or 'No').
Small pause before saving to ensure the UI applied changes and any dependent AJAX completed.
Click the Save Category action (tries common Save selectors: button[title='Save Category'] or input[value='Save Category']).
steps.cssSelector: button[title='Save Category'], input[title='Save Category'], input[value='Save Category']

steps.description: Wait for the save to start and for potential blocking overlay to appear/disappear; allow server/JS processing time (adjust with wait_timeout if necessary).
Capture page notifications and the category tree text to validate the subcategory was created.
steps.goal: Verify save: extract any success message text and the left-hand category tree entries to confirm the new category {name} appears.

input_schema.name: base_url
input_schema.description: Full URL of the Magento Admin Categories page (example: 'http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/admin/catalog_category/'). Must point to the categories listing/edit entry point.

input_schema.name: parent_category_name
input_schema.description: Exact visible text of the parent category node in the left-hand category tree (include count in parentheses if shown, e.g. 'Bot Root Category (0)').

input_schema.name: name
input_schema.description: Category 'Name' value to set for the new subcategory.

input_schema.name: url_key
input_schema.description: Category 'URL Key' value (slug) to set for the new subcategory (lowercase, hyphenated). If you want Magento to auto-generate it leave as an empty string ''.

input_schema.name: is_active
input_schema.description: Set 'Is Active' for the new category. Use the visible option text exactly: 'Yes' or 'No'.

input_schema.name: cms_block
input_schema.description: Visible text of the CMS Block to select in 'CMS Block' (for example 'Home & Decor'). Use the exact option label as shown in the admin select box.

input_schema.name: is_anchor
input_schema.description: Set 'Is Anchor' (visible option text). Use 'Yes' or 'No'.

input_schema.name: wait_timeout
input_schema.description: Maximum seconds to wait for blocking overlays/loaders (default 30).
